notes: Read all 288 source lines before editing. Module is the dashboard 'Motor History' widget: it reads the motor telemetry history (GET /api/v1/motor?vehicle_id={id}&limit=200) for the selected (or first) vehicle, turns MotorSnapshot[] into time-sorted chart data, and renders a WidgetChartSummary with two latest summary stats (Torque/Stator) plus a dual-axis time-series chart (torque + stator temp lines, a 100 C danger band, and dashed lateral/longitudinal g overlays on wide layouts). Purpose, the two size-driven layouts, and the SI->display temperature conversion are preserved in the native header comment.

Imports (L1-17): useMemo (L1) preserved (plus useCallback/useState for the inlined hooks + the chart's onLayout width). react-i18next useTranslation (L2) -> a local English-fallback useTranslation('dashboard') whose t(key, fallback?) returns the fallback (or key), every key preserved. lucide-react Cog (L3) -> the app SemanticIcon 'settings' glyph rendered as a colour-tinted AppText (GlyphIcon): accent in the header (web text-neon-cyan, L160), muted in the EmptyState slot (web h-5 w-5, no colour, L149/L166). @/components/charts ComposedChart/Line/XAxis/YAxis/Tooltip/ReferenceArea/ResponsiveContainer + chartGrid/chartMargin/axisTick/axisTickSm/chartAnimation/fmt (L4-8) -> a native MotorHistoryChart (RN has no Recharts/SVG; see chart note). @/api/hooks/useVehicles useMotorHistory (L9) + useVehicles (L10) -> the already-ported native parity hooks (same names/return shapes; MotorSnapshot imported for buildChartData's typed input). @/hooks/useUnits (L11) -> a settings-derived useUnits() (unitPrefs.temperature/locale). @/lib/numberFormat fmtNumber (L12) -> inlined locale-aware fixed-decimal helper. @/hooks/useDateFormat (L13) -> a settings-derived useDateFormat() exposing formatDateTime. ./shared WidgetChartSummary + ChartSummaryStat (L14) and ./WidgetShell WidgetShell (L15) and ./types WidgetProps (L16) -> local native equivalents (siblings not yet ported); ChartSummaryStat/WidgetSize/WidgetConfig/WidgetProps types ported verbatim. @/lib/unitConversion convertTempFromSI (L17) -> inlined (C passthrough; F = c*9/5+32).

ChartDatum interface (L19-26) ported verbatim: {time, torque:number|null, statorTemp:number|null, gear:string|null, lateralG:number|null, longitudinalG:number|null}. gear is carried through for shape parity even though, exactly as in the source, no series plots it.

buildChartData (L28-50) ported verbatim: items = data ?? [] (L33); filter d.ts || d.created_at (L35); ts = d.ts ?? d.created_at ?? '' (L37); the `raw = d as unknown as Record<string, ...>` cast (L38) is preserved so lateral_accel/longitudinal_accel (absent from the typed MotorSnapshot) are read off the wire (L45-46); statorRaw = d.di_stator_temp ?? d.motor_temp_c_front ?? null (L39); torque = d.di_torque ?? null (L42); statorTemp = statorRaw != null ? toTemperatureDisplay(statorRaw) : null (L43); gear = d.gear ?? d.shift_state ?? null (L44); final sort((a,b)=>a.time.localeCompare(b.time)) (L49). The web `data: ReturnType<typeof useMotorHistory>['data']` param type (L30) becomes the equivalent `MotorSnapshot[] | undefined`.
DANGER_TEMP_C = 100 (L52-53) preserved verbatim; toTemperatureDisplay(DANGER_TEMP_C) drives both the danger band and the temp-axis domain.

Component setup (L55-78): export default function MotorHistoryWidget({vehicleId, size}: WidgetProps) (L55) preserved. useTranslation('dashboard') (L56); const {formatDateTime: formatTime} = useDateFormat() (L57) preserved (alias kept). useVehicles() + vid = vehicleId ?? vehicles?.[0]?.id ?? 0 (L58-59) preserved. useUnits() unitPrefs (L60); toTemperatureDisplay = (v)=>convertTempFromSI(v, unitPrefs.temperature) (L61) preserved but wrapped in useCallback([temperature]) so the chartData/dangerThreshold memos stay stable (behaviourally identical — the conversion depends only on the unit). tempUnit = unitPrefs.temperature (L63). useMotorHistory(vid, 200) destructure of data/isLoading/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch (L65-73) preserved verbatim. chartData = useMemo(buildChartData(data, toTemperatureDisplay), [data, toTemperatureDisplay]) (L75-78) preserved.

Preserved: compact renders the 2-up stat row and drops the chart; the shell shows the overlay freshness chip (no title).

Standard/Wide branch (L157-287): WidgetShell title t('widget.motorHistory.title','Motor History') + icon Cog->settings(accent,13) + {...shellProps} (L158-162) wrapping WidgetChartSummary isEmpty={!hasData} emptyMessage/emptyIcon stats chart={<MotorHistoryChart .../>} (L163-285). WidgetChartSummary (web ./shared): isEmpty -> EmptyState(icon,message) (L28-30 of shared); else a 2-up stat row (web grid-cols-2, truncated 10px muted label + 14px semibold primary value + 10px muted unit) and, when !compact, the chart slot (web mt-2 flex-1).

MotorHistoryChart = the native replacement for the recharts ComposedChart (L169-283). RN ships no Recharts/SVG, so the chart is projected with absolute-positioned <View> line segments (the same technique as the ported Sparkline/MiniChart), measured via onLayout. Faithful mappings: XAxis dataKey='time' tickFormatter formatTime (L172-178) -> first/last formatted-time labels under the plot (formatTime = the same useDateFormat formatter). Left YAxis 'torque' Nm (L180-188) -> an auto-domain [min,max] left scale; its 'Nm' label (wide-only, L187) -> a torque-max end-label fmt(max,0)+' Nm'. Right YAxis 'temp' domain={[0, tempMax]} (L190-200) -> a fixed [0,tempMax] right scale; its tickFormatter `${fmt(v,0)}deg` + tempUnit label (L198-199) -> a temp-max end-label fmt(tempMax,0)+tempUnit. ReferenceArea y1=dangerThreshold y2=tempMax fill #ef4444 fillOpacity 0.1 (L226-232) -> a translucent red danger band <View> between y(dangerThreshold) and y(tempMax) on the temp scale. Line torque #06b6d4 sw2 connectNulls (L234-243) and Line statorTemp #f97316 sw2 connectNulls (L245-254) -> solid 2px cyan/orange segment series; connectNulls is reproduced by projecting only the non-null samples in original-index order. isWide && Line lateralG #a78bfa sw1 strokeDasharray '4 2' connectNulls (L256-268) and isWide && Line longitudinalG #34d399 sw1 strokeDasharray (L269-281) -> 1px purple/green overlays on the SHARED torque (left) axis exactly like yAxisId='torque'; the dash pattern (no rotated-View analog) is approximated with a thinner, 0.8-opacity stroke.

Native-safe omission (rules 4/7, documented): the recharts <Tooltip> (L201-224) is a hover affordance with no touch analog. Its per-series value/label formatter intent (torque->'Nm'/'Torque', statorTemp->tempUnit/'Stator', lateralG->'g'/'Lateral G', longitudinalG->'g'/'Long. G', with the same i18n keys L211/L214/L217/L220) is surfaced as a static colour-keyed legend under the chart, and the latest torque/stator values it would echo are already in the summary-stat row. ResponsiveContainer 100%x100% (L169) -> an onLayout-measured full-width fixed-height (132) plot. chartGrid/chartMargin/chartAnimation (L170-171) are presentational-only and collapse to the native chart's fixed styling.

Native-safe WidgetShell (web ./WidgetShell subset): title/icon/loading/error/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh/children. Skeleton while loading (web L82), an inline danger AppText block testID widget-error (web QueryError L83-87, not yet ported; this widget never passes `error`, so it surfaces only via the freshness 'Error' state), a titled header row (icon + uppercase muted caption title + freshness) or a title-less overlay freshness chip (web L120-164). showFreshness = updatedAt !== undefined; freshnessCompact = !title. DataFreshness is a Pressable(onRefresh) status dot+label (error>fetching>stale>fresh) whose relative time is computed once at render (no 30s interval) to avoid a dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles.

Closing JSX + default export (L286-288) preserved. No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output - only React, RN primitives, the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useMotorHistory/useVehicles/useSettings hooks.
